name: SOS Dan no Houkai
source:
When Haruhi, Mikuru and Yuki are shipwrecked on a tropical beach, many hardships befall them, but none more obscene than Kyon's strange contraption that f*cks them into quivering sex slaves.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE031557.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
涼宮春日、朝比奈實玖瑠與長門有希遭遇海難，漂流到熱帶海灘。她們面臨重重苦難，但沒有什麼比阿虛那臺奇怪裝置更淫穢——它將她們幹到顫抖，變成性奴。
